sorrowful_1-step-01:
Jesus prays in the garden with sorrow unto death. He asks that the cup pass, yet submits fully: "Nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt." He finds the disciples sleeping and calls them to watch and pray. He accepts the Passion in perfect trust.

In Gethsemane, Jesus embraces the Father's will in agony, teaching obedience under suffering.

Stay with this mystery as you pray.
sorrowful_5-step-01:
Jesus is crucified between two criminals. He is mocked, yet forgives and promises paradise to the repentant thief. Darkness falls; then Jesus cries out, "Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit." Then He dies. The centurion recognizes His innocence.

At Calvary, Jesus offers His life completely and opens mercy even at the hour of death.

Stay with this mystery as you pray.
sorrowful_2-step-05: Picture Jesus turning His heart to the Father in prayer.
sorrowful_2-step-08: Ask Christ for purity of heart. Picture His steadfast love for every person.
sorrowful_2-step-10: Picture Jesus remaining faithful to the Father, even when others are unkind.
sorrowful_2-step-11: Picture the love of Jesus reaching you in your own difficulties.
sorrowful_3-step-04: Picture Jesus, the humble King, answering cruelty with patient love.
sorrowful_4-step-03: Picture Jesus beginning the road to Calvary, trusting the Father.
sorrowful_4-step-05: The Stations of the Cross traditionally invite us to remember Jesus falling and rising again. Picture His patient courage on the road.
sorrowful_4-step-06: The Stations of the Cross traditionally invite us to remember Mary meeting Jesus. Picture their loving gaze along the road.
sorrowful_5-step-03: Picture Mary and the beloved disciple remaining near Jesus at the Cross.
